headline: Erste: Political Uncertainty Keeps Romanian Bonds Under Pressure - 10-Year Yield Estimated at 7.49%, Well Above the Region
summary: Erste said political uncertainty is keeping Romanian bonds under pressure. The 10-year yield is estimated at 7.49%, well above the regional level.
why: Government bond yields reflect the borrowing cost of a sovereign and its perceived fiscal and political risk.
